initialExam.title: Himachal Pradesh Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: HP Police Constable recruitment for constable posts in Himachal Pradesh state police force.
initialExam.syllabus: GK, HP GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Hindi, English, General Science.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Measurement Test → Physical Efficiency Test → Medical → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit hppolice.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension, Hill area allowance
